snippet.title: Adidas Power Soccer 98 (PS1) - Full Game Longplay
snippet.description:
Charging up devastating Predator Shots, pulling off bone-crunching arcade tackles, and conquering the World Championship! Watch the complete 100% longplay walkthrough of Adidas Power Soccer 98 for the Sony PlayStation. ⚽ 🔥 🇫🇷 🏆 🥇

Released in 1998 by Psygnosis and developed by Shen Technologies, Adidas Power Soccer 98 (starring French international Youri Djorkaeff on the cover) refined the franchise's signature blend of simulation tactics and pure arcade spectacle. Built for the 1998 tournament season, the game pits 58 international teams and club squads against one another across 11 detailed stadiums.

Players can toggle between realistic Simulation rules and chaotic Arcade mode—complete with flaming super shots, dramatic slow-motion replays, bicycle kicks, and fierce sliding tackles—across Exhibition, League, Cup, and Training modes.

In this full longplay walkthrough, I play through the entire International Cup Campaign from start to finish—demonstrating undefeated group and knockout victories, spectacular Predator Power Shot goals, crisp passing combinations, and lifting the World Championship trophy!

In this PS1 Adidas Power Soccer 98 Longplay:
✅ Full International Cup Walkthrough (Undefeated Championship Run)
✅ Complete Gameplay Showcase: Predator Power Shots, Bicycle Kicks & Arcade Tackles
✅ Arcade Mode vs. Simulation Mode Highlights
✅ Classic 1998 Era International Squads & Iconic Stadium Atmospheres
✅ Authentic 1998 PlayStation 1 3D Visuals & Big-Beat Soundtrack
✅ 100% Raw Gameplay - No Commentary

Game Information:
Released: 1998
Developer: Shen Technologies SARL
Publisher: Psygnosis
Platform: PlayStation (PS1)
Played by: Gremolin
